# oblique_owner (Resource)

Owner is the primary point of contact for the Oblique server.

This API is a singleton resource (https://google.aip.dev/156), and as such only supports Get and Update methods.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The owner is a singleton resource representing the primary point of
# contact for the Oblique instance. There is exactly one owner at any time,
# and the owner has the highest level of administrative privileges.
#
# The referenced user must already exist.
data "oblique_user" "janedoe" {
  email = "janedoe@example.com"
}

resource "oblique_owner" "owner" {
  user = data.oblique_user.janedoe.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user` (String) The user that's designated as the server owner. Always required when updating, but may be empty during initial provisioning.

Format: `users/{user}`

### Optional

- `name` (String) Always the single string "owner".

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) The time this API object was created.
- `id` (String) The ID is a computed type that always matches 'name'. This exists to enable Terraform import.
- `update_time` (String) The time this API object was last updated.
